items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: Ken, Barbara, Sylvia, Mrs. Willis... And I was... What's her call? Sergeant at Arms.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, Sophie. I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

The officers of the Society were... Ken, Barbara... Uh... Ken, Barbara, Sylvia, Mrs. Willis... And I was... What's her call? Sergeant at Arms. You were? Thank you, sir. Wow. Can you tell me? You said you, too.
I didn't want to do the Marines, though they used to be held fired. We had to be held privately. Yeah, we had to be...
